mode.description: outline traverses objects and nested definitions; resolve-block resolves an explicit occurrence path and reports shared-definition impact. Resolution does not require selection eligibility or grant editor ownership; nested definition members are not standalone edit IDs.

options.description: For outline: ids (root GUID array) or path (one occurrence GUID array), mutually exclusive; otherwise scope=selected (default), viewport or document. depth=0..64 (default 64, root=0); max_items=1..5000 (default 200) also bounds visits; max_bytes=2048..262144 (default 48000). Optional field_groups is a nonempty array of summary, objects, annotations, transforms; omitted defaults to summary unless legacy detail flags are supplied. include_geometry and annotations are optional booleans controlling their details; annotation_layer filters text dots by layer path/name. Narrow ids/path/depth after truncation. For resolve-block, only path is accepted: 1..65 GUIDs from the top-level instance inward. The last GUID is an instance occurrence, not its definition ID; returned definition_impact scans placed occurrences within 100000 visits/depth 64 and lists up to 512 paths and containers.

preserve_scale.description: Keep Rhino's real-world dimensions instead of normalizing the model to a one-metre display prop.

behavior.description: Optional semantic preset: auto infers from the name; architecture is fixed; object is movable and affected by gravity; animated is script-driven. This selects physics intent and does not generate animation.

asset_loads.description: add the gravity loads of placed library assets (estimated self weight plus in-use contents/occupants from each asset's load entry, e.g. a filled bathtub) where they stand on (or hang from) the frame. Placements come from Rhino objects tagged with an Almond asset id. Native engine only; the result's "asset_loads" lists every placement with its load and carrying members, or why it was not applied.

connections.description: "rigid" (default: every joint transmits moment) or "simple": beams are pinned (major-axis bending released) and braces pinned in both axes where they stop - not where another member carries on in line - while columns stay continuous. Typical bolted steel and timber framing is closer to "simple"; rigid joints can flatter beam deflection. A curve's user text almond:release = "pinned" | "pinned_start" | "pinned_end" | "rigid" overrides either mode. Native engine.

design_basis.description: "en1990" (default): deflection at SLS characteristic (G + Q), member checks at ULS 1.35 G + 1.5 Q. G = self weight, floor build-up and the weight of placed items; Q = load_kn, the occupancy floor load, contents and occupants. "unfactored" checks both at G + Q (the Karamba route's basis). Native engine.

design_code.description: design code profile for the numbers a code or National Annex sets (gamma_G, gamma_Q, psi_0, xi, gamma_M0, gamma_M1, deflection limit): "eurocode" (default, EN recommended values), any profile from list_design_codes, or "off" (unfactored G + Q, no partial factors; same as design_basis="unfactored"). Results carry "design_code" with the values used and any unverified ones.

detail.description: native engine only. Adds "members" (per member: role, length, section, ULS design forces N/V/M/T, governing combination and check, slenderness, chi, stress, utilization, SLS deflection and span/deflection ratio, pinned ends) and "supports" (reactions Fx..Mz at SLS and each ULS combination). Off by default to keep replies short.

fabrication.description: hollow steel sections (CHS/RHS) are "cold_formed" (default, EN 10219, buckling curve c) or "hot_finished" (EN 10210, curve a; a0 for S460). The difference is up to about 23 % in buckling resistance; use hot_finished only when specified.

fixed_supports.description: True = fully fixed supports, False = pinned (rotations free).

floor_dead_kn_m2.description: superimposed dead load in kN/m2 (floor build-up, finishes) on the same bays.

floor_load_kn_m2.description: imposed floor load in kN/m2 (e.g. 2.0 for homes, EN 1991-1-1 category A) on every bay enclosed by beams on a level; the beams take it by the 45-degree rule (two-way, one-way above 2:1). Native engine only. A code floor load already covers movable furniture and people: combine it with asset_loads only for heavy specific items, and set load_kn to 0 to avoid double counting.

guids.description: Current Rhino object GUID strings in the analysis scope.

span_m.description: structural span in meters for the L/250 limit when members are split at every node (e.g. a 6.2 m joist drawn as two 3.1 m segments). Native engine only.

stability.description: "auto" (default): elastic critical load factor alpha_cr for every ULS combination (EN 1993-1-1 5.2.1) and sway imperfections phi = 1/200 x alpha_h x alpha_m (5.3.2) in +/-x and +/-y; alpha_cr < 10 runs a second-order (P-Delta) ULS analysis, alpha_cr <= 1 fails as unstable. "off": first-order without imperfections.

structure_type.description: Analysis template to use. Options: "beam" — simple beam bending/deflection "truss" — axial force/buckling analysis "shell" — shell stress/displacement "frame" — moment/shear frame analysis "canopy" — cantilevered canopy "gridshell" — large deformation gridshell "membrane" — form-finding membrane "highrise" — high-rise structural systems

uls_combination.description: "6.10" or "6.10ab" (the worse of 6.10a and 6.10b per member). Default: the design code's choice (Eurocode profile: 6.10). A profile that prescribes one expression overrides the request (with a warning).

asset_loads.description: add the loads of placed library assets (native engine), as in validate_structure; loaded points are drawn with load arrows.

beam_diameter_mm.description: Optional circular member outside diameter in millimetres.

beam_wall_mm.description: Optional hollow member wall thickness in millimetres.

connections.description: "rigid" or "simple", as in validate_structure; pinned ends are drawn as small circles.

deflection_limit_ratio.description: span/ratio limit, e.g. 250 for L/250. Default: the design code's limit (Eurocode profile: 250).

G = self weight, floor build-up and the weight of placed items; Q = load_kn, the occupancy floor load, contents and occupants. "unfactored" checks both at G + Q (the Karamba route's basis). Native engine.

Results carry "design_code" with the values used and any unverified ones.

display_guids.description: draw only these members (e.g. one frame line for a section view); the analysis still covers every member in guids.

engine.description: "auto" (default: Almond's native frame solver, no Karamba needed; Karamba when the selection has shells or the bridge cannot export a model), "native" or "karamba".

fixed_supports.description: True = fully fixed supports, False = pinned (rotations free).

floor_dead_kn_m2.description: superimposed dead load in kN/m2 (floor build-up, finishes) on the same bays.

floor_load_kn_m2.description: imposed floor load in kN/m2 (e.g. 2.0 for homes, EN 1991-1-1 category A) on every bay enclosed by beams on a level; the beams take it by the 45-degree rule (two-way, one-way above 2:1). guids.description: Curve GUIDs of the structural axes plus point GUIDs marking supports (see fixed_supports). Without points, the lowest nodes are supported.

load_kn.description: Total imposed load in kN, shared equally by the free nodes (-Z).

physics.description: False draws the same members as plain geometry with no analysis overlay ("physics off"), for before/after comparisons.

reanalyze.description: False re-uses the last solve and only changes the display (scale / color_by / reveal / physics / title) - cheap enough to animate.

reveal.description: 0..1 fraction of members drawn (for staged construction playback).

scale.description: deformation exaggeration; omit for automatic (~6% of span).

span_m.description: reference span in meters for the limit (default: longest member). Set it when members are split at every node, e.g. a 6.2 m joist drawn as two 3.1 m segments.

view.description: "deflection" (default) or "buckling": draw the first buckling mode of the governing ULS combination with its alpha_cr (STABLE >= 10, SWAY-SENSITIVE 1-10, UNSTABLE <= 1) instead of the deflected shape.
